description: Call this to discover existing campaigns before reporting on performance or scheduling new sends. Returns campaigns for the active tenant with status, channel, send date, and top-level engagement metrics (sent, open rate, click rate). Filter by status (DRAFT/SCHEDULED/SENT/FAILED), channel (EMAIL/SMS), or date range. Use the returned campaign id to call nevent_get_campaign (full content + metrics) or nevent_get_campaign_insights (AI analysis).

channel.description: Filter by channel: EMAIL | SMS | WHATSAPP

date_from.description: Filter campaigns created on or after this date (ISO 8601, e.g. "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z")

date_to.description: Filter campaigns created on or before this date (ISO 8601, e.g. "2024-12-31T23:59:59Z")

limit.description: Maximum number of campaigns to return (default 50, max 200)

sort.description: Field to sort by: createdAt (default) | executedAt | name

status.description: Filter by campaign status: EXECUTED | DRAFT | PAUSED | STOPPED | SCHEDULED

name: nevent_list_campaigns
